public_upstream.fix_subject: avcodec/nvdec: don't double free the fdd-owned context on the sep_ref error path

oh_source.l4_evidence: OH ff_nvdec_start_frame_sep_ref (nvdec.c:599) keeps 'ret = AVERROR(ENOMEM); goto fail;' at the decoder_pool exhaustion branch and the trailing 'fail: nvdec_fdd_priv_free(cf); return ret;' block — exactly what upstream removed. Naming-era note: OH uses ff_refstruct_pool_get, upstream patch context shows av_refstruct_pool_get (same API after the ff_->av_ rename); structure equivalent

vulnerability.summary: nvdec hardware decode: when decoder surfaces are exhausted inside ff_nvdec_start_frame_sep_ref, the error path frees the fdd-owned context that ff_nvdec_start_frame already handed to the frame — double free on a crafted video file with NVDEC.
vulnerability.trigger: crafted video driving NVDEC into the sep_ref pool-exhaustion error path
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level confirmed (L4); runtime repro requires NVIDIA GPU + NVDEC-capable build — declared as source-level if submitted
